University of Kashmir

NOTICE
It is notified for the information of all the candidates who have submitted their online application forms
in response to Advertisement Notice No. 07 of 2026 dated March 31, 2026, for the posts of Workshop
Superintendent and Workshop Instructor, respectively, that the provisional list of applicants is given in
Annexures I and II to this Notice.
Further, if the candidate finds any discrepancy regarding his or her credentials, he or she may approach
in person the office of the Recruitment Section of the University of Kashmir with documentary proof
within 7 days from the date of issuance of this notice.
By Order,
